focus_areas: Verification of eyespot (ocellus) morphology and placement.
Edge sharpness between dark wings and yellow background.
Structural integrity of legs and their interaction with the flower surface.
Consistency of body segmentation and hair texture.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the leg-flower interface. AI often struggles with thin limbs interacting with complex textures like flower petals. Check if the legs appear to float or melt. Also, verify if the eyespot geometry is perfectly circular or shows warping, which is a common artifact.

The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying a uniform dark brown color with a distinct eyespot (ocellus) on the visible wing. The body appears fuzzy and brown, blending with the wings. Antennae are visible extending from the head. The background consists of blurred yellow flowers and green foliage.
